incoming.fix: Edit WP-25a.md. (a) Add rule `paths` to `--only`: in docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/code-map.md, flag `(?<![\w./-])(?:inject/|app/src\b)`, except on lines between two `<!-- mv-map -->` marker lines. Skip non-regular files such as submodule gitlinks, and any path with a `tests` component. A PATHS entry that does not exist exits 2. `--root` defaults to `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]`. (d) Usage: take string literals matching `usage: flat3d-inject ([^"]*)`, split on `|`, take each alternative's first word, and skip words starting with `{`, `<` or `[` (cli/link.rs has `format!("usage: flat3d-inject {form}")`). (g) Tests run check.py via `subprocess` with `sys.executable` and `Path(__file__).with_name('check.py')`. (h) Done-check becomes `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/docs -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -W error -m py_compile tools/docs/check.py tools/docs/test_check.py && python3 tools/docs/check.py --only private --allow /dev/null tools/docs/check.py tools/docs/test_check.py`.
